quality.sentenceEn: Talking with local producers I learned that a small part of the production is sometimes wasted due to problems with size or shape, but the quality of the products remains unchanged.
quality.translationZh: 与当地生产商交谈时，我了解到，有时一小部分产品会因大小或形状问题而被浪费，但产品质量保持不变。
quality.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

quality.sentenceEn: We may develop a habit of being so focused on maintaining a perfect appearance that we never cultivate the inner qualities necessary to sustain and deepen intimacy and connection.
quality.translationZh: 我们可能会养成过分注重维持完美外表的习惯，以至于从未培养出维持和深化亲密关系与人际连接所必需的内在品质。
quality.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

quality.sentenceEn: If we redirect our attention toward cultivating inner qualities , we might find a magnetic attraction that moves us from something superficial to something that connects us to our depths.
quality.translationZh: 如果我们将注意力转向培养内在品质，或许会发现一种强大的吸引力，引导我们从表面的事物走向能与我们内心深处相连的东西。
quality.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

quality.sentenceEn: For some of us, persuasion is an instinctive quality and the power of influencing comes naturally.
quality.translationZh: 对我们中的一些人来说，说服力是一种本能特质，影响他人的能力与生俱来。
quality.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

quality.sentenceEn: One who enjoys playing games that require management skills to win might possess more qualities of a manager.
quality.translationZh: 喜欢玩这类需要管理技能才能获胜的游戏的人，可能具备更多的管理者素质。

quality.sentenceEn: They may neglect to cultivate the inner qualities that matter more.
quality.translationZh: 他们可能会忽视培养那些更为重要的内在品质。

quickly.sentenceEn: The problem is that, with the fibre removed, fruit juice's fructose is absorbed more quickly .
quickly.translationZh: 问题在于，去除纤维后，果汁中的果糖吸收速度更快。

quickly.sentenceEn: As it is easy to consume large amounts of fruit juice quite quickly , extra calories are taken in.
quickly.translationZh: 由于很容易快速摄入大量果汁，人们会因此摄入额外的热量。

quickly.sentenceEn: However, after talking to my friends who felt the same, I quickly realised that it wasn't my ignorance but the lack of financial education in our schooling system that is leaving high schoolers seriously behind in the modern world of money.
quickly.translationZh: 然而，当我和有同样感受的朋友们交流后，我很快意识到，这并非我的无知，而是我们学校教育体系中金融教育的缺失，使得高中生在现代金钱世界中严重落后。
quickly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

quickly.sentenceEn: Diving headfirst into the crash course of starting university, I've quickly tried to get myself up to speed with the financial terms of the modern era to help manage my personal finances.
quickly.translationZh: 一头扎进大学新生的速成适应期，我迅速学习掌握了现代金融术语，以帮助管理我的个人财务。
quickly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

quickly.sentenceEn: Reading a book on how to learn a foreign language quickly allows you to feel like you are making progress ("Hey, I'm figuring out the best way to do this!").
quickly.translationZh: 阅读一本关于如何快速学习外语的书，会让你感觉自己正在取得进步（“嘿，我正在找出最好的学习方法呢！”）。

quickly.sentenceEn: He has difficulty taking notes quickly .

quit.sentenceEn: Martin Neil Baily, an economist who is leading a research project on retirement security, notes that quitting a career can lead to feelings of isolation and loneliness, particularly for men.
quit.translationZh: 负责领导退休保障研究项目的经济学家马丁·尼尔·贝利指出，结束职业生涯可能会导致孤立感和孤独感，对男性而言尤其如此。
quit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

quit.sentenceEn: You see, she was planning to quit the job she hates and retire early.
quit.translationZh: 你看，她原本打算辞掉那份讨厌的工作，提前退休。
quit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第15段，第2句

quit.sentenceEn: They were less likely to quit their jobs; indeed, over the next four years, they were 40% less likely to quit than those who kept working under the old policies.
quit.translationZh: 他们辞职的可能性更小；事实上，在接下来的四年里，他们辞职的可能性比那些继续按照旧政策工作的人低40%。

quit.sentenceEn: But even if large numbers of people are quitting bottled water because of care for the environment, others are taking it up.
quit.translationZh: 但即使有很多人因为环保考虑而放弃瓶装水，另一些人却开始饮用瓶装水。

quit.sentenceEn: What happens when people try to quit smoking gradually?
quit.translationZh: 当人们尝试逐渐戒烟时会发生什么？

quit.sentenceEn: It is the way to quit a job one hates.
quit.translationZh: 这是辞去自己讨厌的工作的方法。

quantity.sentenceEn: Lift-off is usually the most environmentally harmful stage of any space mission, with vast quantities of fuel burnt up in a matter of minutes.
quantity.translationZh: 对于任何太空任务而言，发射通常是对环境危害最大的阶段，大量燃料在短短几分钟内燃烧殆尽。
quantity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

quantity.sentenceEn: For example, if you're a dedicated athlete you might need to consume higher quantities of protein.
quantity.translationZh: 例如，如果你是一名专注的运动员，可能需要摄入更多的蛋白质。
quantity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

quantity.sentenceEn: And the quality and quantity of work I can do emerges directly from my ability to concentrate.
quantity.translationZh: 而我工作的质量和数量，直接取决于我的专注力。
quantity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

quantity.sentenceEn: Additionally, the government is planning to increase the quantity of recycled plastic in the market.
quantity.translationZh: 此外，政府正计划增加市场中再生塑料的供应量。
quantity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

quantity.sentenceEn: What do we learn about the quantity and quality of the speaker's work?
quantity.translationZh: 关于说话者工作的数量和质量，我们了解到什么？

quantity.sentenceEn: People now care more about quality than quantity .
quantity.translationZh: 现在人们更注重质量而非数量。

qualified.sentenceEn: One survey taker explained, "The greatest challenge for me was continuing to believe in myself, when all the messages I was getting were that I would never be taken seriously or promoted or given raises at the same rate as men, who were clearly less qualified and not as smart as I was."
qualified.translationZh: 一位受访者解释道：“对我来说，最大的挑战是继续相信自己，尽管我收到的所有信息都表明，我永远不会像那些明显资历较低、不如我聪明的男性那样受到重视、获得晋升或同等加薪。”
qualified.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

qualified.sentenceEn: They tend to undervalue the opinions of others, which means they have trouble believing that anyone is qualified to give them useful feedback.
qualified.translationZh: 他们往往低估他人的意见，这意味着他们难以相信有人有资格给他们提供有用的反馈。
qualified.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

qualified.sentenceEn: Research by the Boston College Center for Work & Family, which surveyed new parents at four large US companies who were qualified for taking at least six weeks paid parental leave, found that 81% of the 1,240 employees surveyed said the notion of fathers taking leave has become more acceptable.
qualified.translationZh: 波士顿学院工作与家庭中心对美国四家大型公司中符合至少六周带薪育儿假条件的新手父母进行了调查。该研究发现，在1240名受访员工中，81%的人表示父亲休育儿假的观念已变得更易被接受。

qualified.sentenceEn: There's also a qualified self, which is who I am, what are my activities, my social network, and all of these aspects are not reflected in any of these measurements.
qualified.translationZh: 此外，还有一种可被称为“质性自我”，它关乎我是谁、我的日常活动、我的社交网络，而所有这些方面都无法通过任何量化指标来体现。
qualified.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

qualified.sentenceEn: Students may no longer be qualified for financial aid if they perform poorly in school or if their family income has increased.
qualified.translationZh: 如果学生在校成绩不佳或家庭收入增加，他们可能会失去获得经济援助的资格。

qualified.sentenceEn: It keeps many otherwise qualified women off the runway.
qualified.translationZh: 这使得许多原本具备资质的女性无法走上T台。

qualify.sentenceEn: Researchers concluded that those who just barely qualified for a grant were able to get twice as much money within the next eight years as those who just missed out.
qualify.translationZh: 研究人员得出结论，那些勉强获得资助的科学家在接下来的八年内能够获得的资金是那些刚好错失资助的科学家的两倍。

qualify.sentenceEn: To qualify for the bonus, they must maintain a healthy weight.
qualify.translationZh: 要获得这笔奖金，员工必须保持健康体重。
qualify.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

qualify.sentenceEn: You just have to do a little thinking ahead and redefine what qualifies as dinner.
qualify.translationZh: 你只需要提前稍作规划，并重新定义晚餐的概念。

qualify.sentenceEn: But according to Aristotle—a student of Plato and teacher of Alexander the Great—most relationships don't qualify as true friendships.
qualify.translationZh: 但据亚里士多德——柏拉图的学生、亚历山大大帝的老师——所言，大多数人际关系都算不上真正的友谊。

qualify.sentenceEn: The report qualifies the more optimistic findings of another new paper which suggests that the world will not have to dig up a lot more land for farming in order to feed 9 billion people in 2050, as the Food and Agriculture Organisation has argued.
qualify.translationZh: 该报告对另一篇新论文中更为乐观的研究结果进行了修正。那篇论文认为，世界无需像联合国粮农组织所主张的那样，为了在2050年养活90亿人口而开垦大量新的耕地。
qualify.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

qualify.sentenceEn: Who will qualify for the bonus in Mexican oil company?
qualify.translationZh: 墨西哥石油公司的哪些员工有资格获得这笔奖金？

quantitative.sentenceEn: We are not born to handle quantitative distinctions skillfully.
quantitative.translationZh: 我们并非生来就能熟练地进行数量区分。

quantitative.sentenceEn: Human brains come equipped with certain quantitative instincts that are refined with age, but these instincts are very limited.
quantitative.translationZh: 人类大脑天生具备某些数量本能，这些本能会随着年龄增长而得到完善，但它们的能力非常有限。

quantitative.sentenceEn: In the absence of the cultural traditions that fill our lives with numbers from infancy, we would all struggle with even basic quantitative distinctions.
quantitative.translationZh: 如果没有从婴儿时期就用数字充斥我们生活的文化传统，我们所有人甚至连基本的数量区分都会感到困难。

quantitative.sentenceEn: Indeed, work with some other species suggests they too can refine their quantitative thought if they are introduced to the cognitive power tools we call numbers.
quantitative.translationZh: 事实上，对其他一些物种的研究表明，如果让它们接触我们称之为数字的认知工具，它们也能改进自身的数量思维能力。

quantitative.sentenceEn: Number words and their written forms transform our quantitative reasoning as they are introduced into our cognitive experience by our parents, peers and school teachers.
quantitative.translationZh: 数字词汇及其书面形式在被父母、同伴和学校老师引入我们的认知经验后，改变了我们的定量推理能力。

quantitative.sentenceEn: Making quantitative distinctions is not an inborn skill.
quantitative.translationZh: 进行数量区分并非与生俱来的技能。
